name: cpp-performance
description: Measure C++ honestly and find where a slowdown comes from: skills for benchmark hygiene (a correctness gate with a deliberately wrong copy before any timing, a controlled twin, alternating runs with median and spread, a scaling curve, the order a benchmark visits things in), a slowdown ladder (isolate, separate the steps, pad, read the assembly, test code placement with -mbranches-within-32B-boundaries, perf and strace without hardware counters), measuring on a CI runner through a workflow_dispatch template, and honest claims (quiet re-run, size of the cost, the cost on the other side, correct by replacing), with runnable scripts and fixtures that need only GCC.
